{"fields" [ {"fieldId":"fldtJk12n7Ohp0BHz",
"purpose":"Stores a short, standardized identifier for a demographic group (demoCode) in the 🔷👥DemoGroups table. Serves as the human- and machine-readable label used to link demo group records to participants, eligibility rules, automations, and reports. It is filled as a single-line text string following project naming conventions—either entered manually by data staff or populated by an Airtable automation/script when a demo group is created.",
"process":"Used in the eligibility and cohort-management workflow: demoCode links demographic group definitions to participant records, inclusion/exclusion criteria, cohort assignment, and downstream reporting/exports for analysis and enrollment decisions."},{
  "purpose": "Holds the name/label of a demographic group used by the ARCHR Eligibility project to identify and categorize population segments (e.g., age/race/gender-based groups). It is a single-line text field intended to store the canonical group name for each record in the DemoGroups table.",
  
"process": "Used in the eligibility and cohort-assignment workflow: records are referenced when applying inclusion/exclusion rules, filtering or segmenting participants, and producing group-specific reports or outreach. The field is populated by manual data entry or bulk import as a single-line text value, typically following an internal naming convention or controlled vocabulary so groups can be matched consistently across the eligibility pipeline."
},{"fieldId":"fldTECp1XjAemVzYv",
"purpose":"Stores the filter terms or formula fragments used to perform demographic (‘demo’) checks for a DemoGroup. As a single-line text field it contains the keywords/operators (e.g., comma‑separated keywords or Airtable filter fragments) that are either entered by a data manager or generated by an automation to define the group’s demo-check filter.",
"process":"Used in the [P] ARCHR Eligibility workflow to screen participants by demographic criteria — powering automated demo-checks, record filtering/segmentation, and downstream eligibility/assignment decisions."},{"fieldId":"fldJ0f3ikHT9tx9ee",
"purpose":"Stores which engagement/form option is associated with a demographic group (for example a language or form variant such as “English”, “Spanish”, “online”, “paper”). It is a single-line text field that is populated when a DemoGroup record is created or updated — typically entered by staff or set by an import/mapping from intake/eligibility data.",
"process":"Used in the ARCHR Eligibility workflow to route participants and demo groups to the correct consent/screening/survey form variant, ensure participants receive the appropriate language/format, and support enrollment tracking and reporting."},{"fieldId":"fldTtEsvmAa6wCzno",
"purpose":"Stores a single-line text sort key used to control the order of records in the 🔷👥DemoGroups table—i.e., a display/ordering value (ordinal or label) that determines how demo groups appear in lists. It is populated either manually when arranging groups or automatically by a script/automation that writes the sort value.",
"process":"Used in the ARCHR Eligibility workflow to produce consistently ordered lists and exports of demographic groups for review, cohort selection, reporting, and other eligibility-related UI views and downstream processes."},{"fieldId":"fldhV5UZOfuYzdFlk",
"purpose":"Records which SPA form option/variant applies to a DemoGroup record in the ARCHR Eligibility base. As a single-line text field it is populated with the chosen form identifier or short label (entered manually during data entry or set by an automation/selection control) to indicate the specific SPA form to use for that group.",
"process":"Used in the ARCHR eligibility workflow to determine which SPA form/version is presented or applied for a demographic group—driving form routing, eligibility checks, and downstream documentation or automations for enrollment and reporting."},{
  "purpose": "Holds a numeric triage score for a demographic group used to indicate eligibility priority or urgency within the ARCHR Eligibility base. It is used to rank or filter DemoGroups for follow‑up, screening, or allocation decisions. The field may be populated either by an automated triage/eligibility calculation or by manual entry from a reviewer/triage team; the exact fill method is not specified in the provided context.",
  
"process": "Part of the eligibility triage workflow: scores in this field are used to prioritize and select demographic groups for outreach, further screening/enrollment, or downstream reporting and resource allocation in the ARCHR program."
}]}

{"fields" [ {
  "purpose": "Capture a short, single-line note identifying the person or source that completed the child’s demographic information (e.g., staff name, guardian, or brief status note) so the record shows who filled out the child-specific demo data.",
  
"process": "Populated at intake/eligibility screening — entered manually into the single-line text field by staff or auto-filled from an intake form when child demographics are collected. },{"fieldId":"fldr2XBmV5IZUuFVV",
"purpose":"Stores one or more standardized demographic or category tags collected during a fill-out step in the ARCHR Eligibility base. It allows recording multiple applicable demographic attributes (predefined options) for an individual or record to support consistent classification and reporting.",
"process":"Populated by selecting one or more predefined options via the intake form or manual data entry when completing eligibility/demo information. The field feeds recruitment and eligibility workflows—used for screening, cohort segmentation, filtering records for studies or programs, and generating reports/metrics during enrollment and participant management."},{"fieldId":"fldouT6CCck7Dzp7O",
"purpose":"Holds the age-related value collected in the demographics fill-out labeled “FILLOUT_HOME_AGE.” The field is a single-line text entry intended to capture the reported age (either of a household member or, if intended, the dwelling) as provided during intake.",
"process":"Manually populated at intake/eligibility screening or via a respondent-facing form by entering the value into this single-line text field. The captured value is used in the [P] ARCHR Eligibility workflow for demographic profiling, eligibility assessment, reporting, and downstream segmentation/outreach."},{"fieldId":"fldGukn1HOwIsFlyT",
"purpose":"Stores the homeowner’s age as a demographic data point within the ARCHR Eligibility base. Used to capture an individual’s age for eligibility checks, age-based rule evaluation, and demographic reporting or segmentation.",
"process":"Single-line text value entered during the homeowner fillout/intake step. Typically populated from the client-facing fillout form or entered manually by staff (or mapped/imported from an intake system) and then used by downstream eligibility logic and reporting."},{"fieldId":"fldSdswwykXzB5Ph1",
"purpose":"Tracks which forms/documents or fill-out requests are required for a record within the ARCHR Eligibility demo categories. It captures one or more predefined request types (e.g., consent, intake, demographic survey) so the team knows what needs to be completed for that participant/record.",
"process":"Populated as a multiple-select from a controlled option list — typically selected by a study coordinator during screening or set automatically by a workflow/script based on eligibility answers. The field is used in the eligibility/onboarding process to drive outreach and task automation (issue requests, send reminders, gate progression into enrollment and data collection)."},{"fieldId":"fld9jT3aIK1swsaHk",
"purpose":"Stores the human-readable name/label for each record in the 🔷_DEMO_CATEGORIES_ table. Serves as the primary display identifier for a demo/demographic category and is used for lookups, filtering, and joins. It is typically populated manually when creating or editing a category, or via bulk import/API when categories are migrated or synced.",
"process":"Used in the ARCHR Eligibility workflow to categorize records (participants/applicants/etc.), drive eligibility rule evaluation, enable filtering/segmentation, and support reporting and downstream matching or enrollment decisions."},{"fieldId":"fldKRxgJvCjlIYSLI",
"purpose":"Holds links to one or more Program Priority records associated with this demographic category in the ARCHR Eligibility base. It indicates which programs or priority levels apply to the demo category. The field is populated by selecting/linking existing Program Priority records (multiple) — typically entered manually during record creation/editing or populated via imports, forms, or automations that link the appropriate Program Priority records.",
"process":"Used in the eligibility/referral workflow to prioritize program placement and routing decisions — i.e., to guide eligibility determinations, client triage, enrollment/referral prioritization, and related reporting or resource-allocation steps within the ARCHR Eligibility process."},{"fieldId":"fldJ3BhwZVOWhOxMC",
"purpose":"This multiple-record link field connects a demographic category record in 🔷_DEMO_CATEGORIES_ to one or more program requirement records (PROG_REQ). It documents which program requirements apply to that demographic category so the base can filter, report on, and enforce requirement relationships.",
"process":"The field is populated by linking existing PROG_REQ records to a demo category—either manually by users selecting links, by importing linked record IDs, or via Airtable automations/scripts. The linked data is used in the ARCHR Eligibility workflow to map demographic categories to program requirements and support eligibility screening, requirement checklists, routing, and reporting (i.e., determining which requirements an applicant in a given demo category must meet)."}]}

"purpose":"This formula field acts as the record Name for the \"Confirm Eligibility Events\" table by mirroring the value of another field ({flducr4jsUwGeC2hz}), creating a standardized, read-only identifier for each eligibility-confirmation event in the ARCHR Eligibility base.",
"process":"Automatically populated by a formula (formulaValue = {flducr4jsUwGeC2hz}); used in the eligibility confirmation workflow to label and link event records, support automations (notifications/status updates), and enable consistent reporting/tracking of participant eligibility confirmation events."},{"fieldId":"fldBySP8TtYhgSr4j",
"purpose":"Stores links from a Confirm Eligibility Event to one or more Partner Program records so the event is explicitly associated with the specific partner program(s) under review. "process":"Populated as a multiple-record link either by the automation that creates Confirm records (🟪Create [☑️] Confirm Records) or manually when an event is entered/edited. "purpose":"Holds one or more URLs linking to the property card(s) associated with a Confirm Eligibility Event so reviewers can quickly access property details needed to assess eligibility.",
"process":"Automatically populated as a multiple lookup from linked property records when an event is connected to those records; used in the eligibility confirmation workflow to retrieve property details for screening, documentation, decisioning and audit/reporting."},{"fieldId":"fldQATn3ZRJXUAOcj",
"purpose":"Holds one or more tag labels originating from the Partner Program record that are relevant to a Confirm Eligibility event. It provides a quick, human-readable list of partner-assigned tags used to categorize or flag the event for downstream handling.",
"process":"This is populated as a multiple-value lookup from the linked Partner Program records (the Partner Program → tagLabel field); values appear when a Partner Program record is linked to the Confirm Eligibility Event and can be updated by linking/unlinking records or by automations that sync Partner Program tags.
